title: Ep 40 — Claude's Cowork Mode Disappears Into Claude Itself, and the AI Headshots Clearing Three Hundred Thousand Dollars a Month
description: Anthropic folds Cowork's background-task features into a single unified Claude experience with new Docs, Slides and Design tools built in, OpenAI opens sponsored in-chat agents and a Shopify ad integration, and Cohere merges with Aleph Alpha as OpenAI reportedly explores a pre-IPO round above one point two trillion dollars. Plus a deep dive on Danny Postma's AI headshot tool HeadshotPro's two-year run at around three hundred thousand dollars a month, and updates for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships including Omaze signing a new prize-draw code of practice and a twenty-third straight quiet episode for sports-venue EV charging.
